name: dsh-archived-cleaner
description: DSH 已归档会话彻底删除插件：列出已归档会话并删除其会话文件与注册表引用，支持逐条删除、多选删除与一键清空。Thoroughly delete archived DSH sessions: list archived sessions and remove their session files plus registry references, with single, batch and clear-all flows.

scripts.test: node tests/path-safety.test.mjs && node tests/registry-lookup.test.mjs && node tests/delete-notify.test.mjs
